Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHFWS Udupi Outreach Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and candidates should attend the interview on 05 August 2026. There is no separate application deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Outreach Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC or equivalent, possess a Karnataka Government recognized Nursing Training Certificate, and a Karnataka Nursing Council Registration Certificate.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Outreach Worker position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for the Outreach Worker post by DHFWS Udupi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Outreach Worker role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Outreach Worker position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the DHFWS Udupi Outreach Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Outreach Worker post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Outreach Worker post will be the minimum wages as fixed by the Labour Department.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. Specific documents include ID proof, educational certificates, and registration certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Udupi, Karnataka. The exact venue address is usually detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: The job type is mentioned as Contractual, indicating that this is not a permanent government position.
